name: ffbeast-remote
description: Control remoto para el volante FFBeast: hub HID en el PC + PWA para PC y movil

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n hub,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @ffbeast/hub" "npm run dev -w @ffbeast/web"
scripts.dev:mock: concurrently -k -n hub,web -c cyan,magenta "cross-env FFBEAST_MOCK=1 npm run dev -w @ffbeast/hub" "npm run dev -w @ffbeast/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ffbeast/hub && npm run build -w @ffbeast/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ffbeast/hub && npm run typecheck -w @ffbeast/web
